newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 29.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Oct 29:
WASHINGTON - McDonnell Douglas Corp.'s chief executive announced that the world's second largest aerospace company is cancelling plans to build a new jumbo jetliner.
WASHINGTON - Maryland and 13 other states sued Mazda Motor of America Inc, accusing the company of deception in advertising its "zero down" and "penny down" auto leasing.

WASHINGTON - High-tech industry leaders are letting loose a stream of announcements this week all aimed at proving their companies will lead what they hope will be the next technology trend -- low cost devices that link users in companies to computer networks.
WASHINGTON - Used software stores help people make money off the programs they no longer need, while others find second-hand software a way to breathe life into their older machines.
